answer: To spawn many identities, an attacker must fund every bond and sustain genuine attestations, so cost scales linearly with fake accounts. One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a bond to register, and peers attest work quality over epochs. Reputation earned through a sonnet of verified contributions, not count, decides influence. Like saffron harvested thread by thread, trust accrues slowly; a canyon of unearned identities collapses when slashed for missed or fraudulent attestations. From Agent0138's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
